# Work Comp Exemption

> Work Comp Exemption (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides workers' compensation exemption filing services for independent contractors, sole proprietors, LLC members, and corporate officers in all 50 states. Services: Florida WC exemption (DFS Certificate of Election), Arizona ICA exemption, Texas non-subscriber guidance, general contractor exemption, sole proprietor exemption, LLC member exemption, corporate officer exemption, and exemption renewal. 15-minute consultations, same-day exemption review. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Exemption services (service pages)

- [Florida WC Exemption](/services/florida-wc-exemption): DFS Certificate of Election to be Exempt — construction contractors, 2-year renewal.
- [Arizona WC Exemption](/services/arizona-wc-exemption): ICA sole proprietor and LLC member exclusion with active-work eligibility.
- [Texas WC Exemption](/services/texas-wc-exemption): Texas non-subscriber framework, occupational accident alternatives.
- [Contractor WC Exemption](/services/contractor-wc-exemption): General and specialty contractor exemption filing in qualifying states.
- [Sole Proprietor Exemption](/services/sole-proprietor-exemption): Single-owner business exemption filing and eligibility determination.
- [LLC Member Exemption](/services/llc-exemption): LLC member and manager exemption with operating agreement review.
- [Corporate Officer Exemption](/services/corporate-officer-exemption): S-corp and C-corp officer election to be exempt, carrier notification.
- [Exemption Renewal](/services/exemption-renewal): Expiration tracking, advance alerts, and renewal filing before lapse.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: workers' compensation **exemption filing** for contractors — not WC insurance itself.
- Services: FL DFS certificates, AZ ICA exclusions, TX non-subscriber, sole prop, LLC, officer, renewal.
- Consultation SLA: ~15 minutes. Exemption review: same day.
- States: licensed and advising in all 50.
- Each page carries 20 niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
